title: Northlake mom accused of stabbing husband, kids held on $2M bond
text:
37-year-old Holly Leeann Flores is charged with two counts of attempted capital murder and one count of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon after allegedly stabbing her husband and two young children in Northlake. All three victims were hospitalized, with the children now in protective custody.
A Northlake mother faces attempted capital murder charges after allegedly stabbing her husband and two young children inside their home. All three victims have been released from the hospital, with the 3-year-old and 10-month-old now in child protective custody.
Holly Flores Faces Two Million Dollar Bond
A Northlake mother accused of stabbing her husband and two young children has been ordered held on a combined $2 million surety body, according to Northlake police on Thursday. 37-year-old Holly Leeann Flores faces two counts of attempted capital murder involving children under 10 and one count of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon. A magistrate set a $1 million surety bond on each attempted capital murder charge, according to an update from the Northlake Police Department.
No bond had been set on the aggravated assault charge as of Thursday's release. A North Texas mom is facing charges after allegedly stabbing her husband and two young children at their home in Denton County, sending all three victims to the hospital early Tuesday morning. The children, a 3-year-old girl and a 10-month-old boy, have been released from the hospital and are in the care of the Texas Department of Family and Protective Services, according to police.
According to the initial news release, Flores was taken to a Denton hospital for observation and possible injuries. She was later treated and released, then taken into custody and transported to the Denton County Jail. The Northlake Police Department gives an update on the arrest for 37-year-old Holly Flores. She's accused of stabbing her husband and two young children.
Police Discover Children Sustained Stab Wounds
Officers were dispatched to a home in the 1200 block of Daylily Drive around 4:20 a.m. Oct. 6 after the Denton County Sheriff's Office communications center received a report that a man's wife had a knife and had stabbed him, police said. Northlake police arrived within minutes and detained the adult woman. During a protective sweep of the home, they found that two young children had suffered stab wounds. The victims were taken to a Fort Worth hospital.
Police said the husband suffered head injuries, while the girl had stab wounds to her chest and the boy suffered a stab wound to his chest.
